messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: P2 alert — elevated 5xx rate observed in region eu3 gateway cluster. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Start: 1957778850. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/edge-5xx-eu

sara (oncall): on it. paging aj and maria. initial scope: overall 5xx spike ~10m ago, trending up. any recent deploys?

aj (eng-sre): digging into logs now. tailing gateway logs, i'm seeing lots of `upstream_timeout` and `request_reset` from gateway-proxy nodes. p50 ok, p95 spikes.

maria (runtime): checking model-serving backends for eu3 — no mass OOMs reported. but I see increased queue length on pool-gpu-2. recent config change to `proxy.keepalive=30s` ~12m ago (maybe unrelated).

deploy-bot: last deploy to edge-proxy-eu3: `edge-proxy@2026-03-14T09:12:03Z` by kevin — diff: keepalive change + connection pool tuning. CI: green.

kevin (platform): that's my deploy. rolled low-risk change. rolling back if we think it's the culprit but want to isolate first.

aj (eng-sre): quick check — increase in `502`/`504` and also `503` from upstream circuit-breaker. Rate of 5xx ~8% across eu3 over 10m, peak ~14% during spike. customer-facing errors visible in SLO dashboard: @cs-bot FYI.

cs-bot: notified support channels and started collecting impacted customer list. will update with customer IDs in ~10m.

sara (oncall): triage plan: 1) throttle traffic to problematic backend pool (pool-gpu-2) 2) open emergency route to eu1 for critical routes 3) scale gateway-eu3 nodes 4) if that fails, rollback keepalive change. executing steps in order.

aj (eng-sre): ack. running quick traffic isolation now — adding routing rule to reduce weight to pool-gpu-2 to 10%.

maria (runtime): while that's happening i'll drain long-running KV caches on pool-gpu-2 and clear prefix cache for /v1/chat to ensure no stuck state.

sara (oncall): running commands:
```
# reduce weight to GPU pool
curl -s -X POST https://routing.internal/api/v1/weights -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"pool":"pool-gpu-2","weight":0.1}'
# scale gateways
kubectl -n infra scale deploy gateway-eu3 --replicas=10
```

sara (oncall): routing API returned 200. gateway replicas scaling from 4 -> 10 (scaling started).

aj (eng-sre): I pushed the weight change, verifying proxies are respecting new upstreams. logs show fewer requests hitting pool-gpu-2 immediately.

kevin (platform): scaling hooks completed on 3 nodes, still booting 3 more. monitoring LB health checks.

maria (runtime): cache drain job started for pool-gpu-2. progress: ~60% cleared.

(some minutes pass)

aj (eng-sre): quick smoke: curl https://eu3.gateway.internal/v1/health -> 200. sample requests to /v1/chat returned 200 and tokens streaming. 5xx rate dropped to ~2.1% in last 5m. p95 latency improved.

sara (oncall): customer impact summary so far: ~6% of production requests in eu3 saw 5xx during the window, estimated 0.4% of total global traffic. CS list will have affected customers. postmortem action: snapshot logs for 09:05-09:25 UTC.

cs-bot: posting impacted customers to #support-incidents shortlink: https://cs.internal/incident/1957778888 — CS will notify top 10 affected customers and provide mitigation notes.

kevin (platform): question — is keepalive config confirmed as root cause? logs show a correlation in timing but nothing conclusive. recommend we rollback the keepalive tweak in a controlled manner.

aj (eng-sre): agree. let's keep it as a follow-up. for now mitigation is holding. we should also check if envoy upstream idle-timeout/unhealthy detection triggered cascades.

sara (oncall): escalation/status: marking as mitigated, not resolved. severity remains P2. moving to monitoring phase for next 30m. will hand to maria for deep-dive and postmortem.

maria (runtime): taking over monitoring and root-cause. I will: 1) run correlation between deploy time and spike, 2) audit envoy and keepalive metrics, 3) validate if pool-gpu-2 queueing patterns match timeout windows.

incidents-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation applied — traffic isolation + scaling. Next action: postmortem assigned to maria, oncall owner for the next 2 hours. Incident channel pinned with runbook and logs.

kevin (platform): leaving a note for rollback plan (if needed): `edge-proxy@keepalive-revert-20260314` ready in staging. will not execute without maria sign-off.

aj (eng-sre): saved a debug bundle: `/var/backups/incident/1957778888-debugbundle.tar.gz` (contains proxy metrics, envoy stats, routing decisions).

maria (runtime): got the bundle, starting analysis. initial hypothesis: aggressive keepalive change increased connection churn causing upstreams to hit circuit-breaker thresholds under burst. will validate.

sara (oncall): handing off — i'm going offline for admin. maria, please take lead and update this thread with timeline and planned RCA. tagging @cs-bot to continue customer comms.

maria (runtime): ack. i'll post RCA timeline and follow-ups here within 24h. taking ownership.

incidents-bot: paging done, incident channel updated, incident status -> mitigated. :information_source:

sara (oncall): final note before handoff — create a canary for keepalive revert in eu3 before any broad rollback. prefer to validate before full revert. :thumbsup:

maria (runtime): noted. will run canary and report. end of live triage thread.
